title: Simulation reconstruction spec
objective: Remove false-negative pressure against multi-stage strategies by reconstructing simulation truth anchors, sequence preservation, and pricing realism before further strategy or AEE refinement.

reconstruction_modules.problem: The system measures profitability but not extraction efficiency.
requirements: compute total_available_pips per trade and per family
classify efficiency bands as broken, weak, viable, or strong
publish available_vs_extracted movement in every benchmark run
reconstruction_modules.expected_effect: Distinguish weak market from weak system and stop hiding low-extraction failures behind small positive PnL.

reconstruction_modules.problem: Current sequence encoding does not represent reclaim behavior despite long paths and high path complexity.
requirements: preserve ordered micro-swings inside each trade path
encode non-monotonic progress transitions rather than only aggregate progress_ratio summaries
retain adverse-to-recovery transitions required for pullback and reclaim forms
support explicit multi-stage state reconstruction: impulse, failure, reclaim, continuation
reconstruction_modules.expected_effect: Increase reclaim representability from 0 toward non-zero and reduce breakout-only survivorship bias.

reconstruction_modules.problem: Bar-1 gains are occasionally too optimistic and spread application is inconsistent.
requirements: define side-aware entry and exit price formation
apply spread consistently at entry, exit, and evaluation layers
track bid/ask or explicit side-aware proxy fields in derived streams
publish fill mismatch diagnostics whenever bar-1 gain exceeds allowed tolerance
reconstruction_modules.expected_effect: Reduce suspicious_fill_rate below 0.05 and increase pricing consistency score.

reconstruction_modules.problem: The current evaluation set is concentrated in compressed and Q4-heavy conditions.
requirements: rebalance benchmark windows by regime and quarter
require benchmark output to show regime-weighted and raw views
separate structural failure from concentration failure in adjudication
reconstruction_modules.expected_effect: Prevent one regime bucket from dominating comparative form ranking.

gating_rules: Do not tune strategy thresholds while simulation reconstruction is incomplete.
Do not conclude concept failure until truth anchor and sequence preservation are live.
Do not refine AEE family logic using simulator outputs that still fail pricing realism checks.
success_conditions: Every benchmark run reports total_available_pips, entry_only_capture, realized_capture, and extraction_efficiency.
Reclaim representability is measurable and non-zero.
Suspicious fill rate is reduced below doctrine threshold.
Benchmark matrix can compare breakout and multi-stage forms on balanced samples.
